title: FLOOR ( -2.5, -2 ) is -2: FLOOR rounds toward zero

source.quote: Rounds a number down, toward zero, to the nearest multiple of significance.
The functions always returns a decimal data type, regardless of the arguments.
source.supports: the result is a decimal number even with an integer significance

derivation: The multiples of -2 around -2.5 are -2 and -4. Toward zero is -2. FLOOR always returns a decimal number: -2.0.
